scope: Post-hoc same-library stability and matched-universe diagnostics. Previous count/TPM outcomes already inspected; no independent biological replication.

omission_suite.variants: Full 40-library length-offset fit, both-ambiguous-P16-record exclusion, and each of 40 single-library omissions: 42 fits total.
omission_suite.filtering: Repeat the frozen length_fit filtering, positive-length checks and normalization independently after every omission.
omission_suite.effects: P18-P10 change in mutant-Control contrast; sign and at-most -log2(1.5) descriptive magnitude. A missing/non-unique gene fails retention.
omission_suite.inference: Full-gene-family BY/BH per variant; cross-variant threshold retention is descriptive, with no additional subgroup or intersection FDR claim.

diagnostic.universe: Intersection of original gene IDs tested in the preceding full TPM and full length-offset count models, fixed before these diagnostic fits.
diagnostic.count_comparison: Same count matrix, genes, ten-cell design, library sizes and TMM factors for both count fits; same robust edgeR v4 QL policy, prior.count=0.125; only centered gene/sample length prior toggled. Dispersions reestimated under each offset.
diagnostic.TPM: log2(TPM+0.5), limma trend=TRUE robust=TRUE on fixed common genes without refiltering.
diagnostic.warning: Zero-offset fit is an intentionally incomplete diagnostic, not a recommended alternative pipeline. Matched comparisons do not fully decompose the original TPM/count difference; model family, scale and normalization still differ.

frozen_priorities: Original 105 candidates and 36 stable downward priorities; unique symbol matching after complete-gene tests. No new candidate selection.
limitations: Biological animal/pooling and barcode/source-code uncertainty persists.
No confidence intervals inferred from omission ranges.
No genes substituted for animals, no new primary genetic-unit vote.
Counts remain RSEM estimates, never rounded; no inferential replicates supplied.
